description: LLM model router — Decide which model tier a prompt needs (small, medium or large) before you pay for a big model. Offline heuristic scoring of code, debugging, math, reasoning words, multi-part questions, context length, output length and routine tasks, with suggested max tokens, temperature and minimum context window. Optional: budget=low|balanced|quality, outputTokens=. No model call, nothing stored. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

prompt.description: e.g. Classify this review as positive or negative: The battery died after two days.
